Name: Valley Girls OhoDavi Style
Author: kanasen
Description:
本图包为VG的OhoDavi风格的替换，主要替换文件有：Animation→MaleSex中所有带头像的动图，及Portraits中所有头像
我已尽力将MaleSex的头像进行动作化，但未测试是否流畅以及观看体验（因为只能用ps调整），因此本图包大概率不再更新，因此无需授权


The graphics package is a replacement in VG's OhoDavi style. The files to be replaced include: all animated portraits in Animation→MaleSex and all portraits in Portraits.
I tried my best in MaleSex, but I haven't tested whether they are smooth or provide a good viewing experience (as I can only adjust them using Photoshop). Therefore, there is a high probability that this graphics package will not be updated, and as a result, no authorization is required.

安装方式：和其他portrait类一样，替换Valley Girls内的同名且同路径文件即可

How to use: just like any other portrait mods, replace the picture in Valley Girls which has the same filename
